note: P is four framings of one cloud type (nacreous/pearl clouds at dusk), all leaning on the same rare-and-unseen idea, though the lines and moments differ somewhat. Q is three near-identical poems about a lenticular cloud holding over a ridge in midwinter wind (Q1, Q2, Q4 share lines and images), with only Q3 offering a different take (a dusk veil with a shell sheen).
